message:
Initial cleanup of ObjectData

Summary: * Moves all inline ObjectData methods out of object-data.h, and into
  object-data-inl.h

* Renames implementsIterator() to isIterator() to match is*Collection().

* Gets rid of the o_ prefix on o_getClassName(), o_getId(), and o_instanceof().

* Deletes a few unnecessary methods such as getAttributes(), setAttributes().

Reviewed By: @edwinsmith
